messages:
Maya: KiteLabs onboarding — seeing intermittent 429s during browser preflight. Customer reports it spikes right after they open the app and then stabilizes.

Maya: Attached log snippet from client (redacted):
```
POST /v1/preflight 429
headers: Authorization: Bearer eyJ... <redacted>
sdk: js@2.1.3
concurrency: 30 tabs
```

Omar: @Maya thanks. Do we know if they're using ephemeral tokens or server-signed keys?

Jin (KiteLabs): We're issuing ephemeral JWTs from our backend, TTL 8s. Client requests about 20 concurrent preflight calls during startup.

Omar: 8s TTL is pretty tight. If they rotate while a request is inflight that can cause handshake churn. Also preflight fanout + no splay = momentary stampede.

Claire: Two quick mitigation suggestions:
- increase token TTL to 30s or add a grace window on server side
- add exponential backoff with jitter on 429
- coalesce preflight calls on the client (singleton promise)

Claire: Example singleton pattern:
```
let preflightPromise = null;
function ensurePreflight() {
  if (!preflightPromise) preflightPromise = doPreflight().finally(() => preflightPromise = null);
  return preflightPromise;
}
```

EngOncall: Also check their proxy/ALB idle timeout — if backend closes connections early clients may open new connections which looks like more concurrency. ALB default 60s vs node keepalive expectations can cause resets.

Omar: From server logs I see short-lived 401s followed by retries that then hit rate limit. So two issues: token churn + retry fanout.

Jin (KiteLabs): We can bump TTL and implement singleton. Quick question: recommended client-side retry/backoff params?

EngOncall: Start with linear backoff + full jitter: base 100ms, max 3s, max retries 5. Also randomize initial delay per tab.

Maya: I'll send these steps to the customer. Also flagging renewal risk low but need to get them past onboarding today.

Omar: I'll provision a temporary rate-limit bump for KiteLabs org for 1 hour (low risk) while they validate.

Jin (KiteLabs): Thanks, team — implementing TTL change and singleton now. Will report back in 15m.

SupportBot: @Omar created temporary quota override (org=kite-123) until 1765443599. Link: https://dash.redwood.ai/orgs/kite-123/quotas

Maya: Customer confirmed improved behavior after TTL -> 30s and singleton. Closing for now, tagging follow-up doc.

Maya: Follow-up items: 1) Doc snippet for common preflight anti-patterns, 2) add guidance to onboarding checklist about ephemeral token TTLs.
